{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This is the only valid approach per the data dictionary

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending), then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the result
print('After deduplication:')
print('Number of unique patients:', len(df_dedup))
print('Number of rows:', len(df_dedup))

# Verify that the deduplication removed exactly 48 rows (the number of duplicate patient_id entries)
print('\nRows removed by deduplication:', len(df) - len(df_dedup))"}
